title: pinout-openapi compatibility report — output canon
description: Frozen output contract (the CLI's postcondition, Design by Contract) of the pinout-openapi compatibility-check CLI. This document IS the machine-readable JSON report emitted to stdout (always) and written to settings.json_report_file (when save_json_report=true). It is the CANONICAL, symmetric report schema: pinout-asyncapi aligns to it later. Derived 1:1 from BRD 'Data dictionary — output (JSON report) — committed canon'. Determinism: identical inputs → byte-identical report body modulo the optional generated_at timestamp.
x-canon: symmetric — pinout-asyncapi aligns to this shape

verdict.description: Overall result. 'incompatible' iff any operation is incompatible; else 'compatible'. Maps to exit 0 (compatible) / exit 1 (incompatible).

name.description: Consumer identity, echoed from config consumer.name.
Provider identity, echoed from config provider.name.

source.description: Resolved provider origin — the spec_url value or the spec_path value actually used.

operations.description: Per-operation compatibility result, one entry per configured consumer operation.

status.description: Per-operation verdict. 'incompatible' iff findings is non-empty.

findings.description: Each mismatch that makes this operation incompatible. Empty when status is 'compatible'.

rule.description: Which of the 5 committed compatibility rules was violated. presence: operation absent from provider. request_contravariance: provider requires a request item the consumer does not send. response_covariance: consumer reads a response field the provider does not provide. status_codes: consumer expects a status the provider does not declare. content_types: content-type mismatch for the operation.

location.description: Where the mismatch is (e.g. the parameter/property/status/content-type pointer within the operation).

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the specific mismatch.

generated_at.description: Optional report generation timestamp (RFC 3339). Excluded from the determinism diff — 'byte-identical modulo timestamps'.

allOf.$comment: Consistency invariant: an incompatible operation carries ≥1 finding; a compatible one carries none.
